name: Youth Volunteer and Intern Applications
what_you_do: Volunteer or intern with a City of Chula Vista department. Jobs change with the time of year, the project and what each department needs. The Animal Care Facility has its own form.
who_can_apply: You must be at least 15 and a half and under 18. If you are 18 or older, use the adult form.
pay_detail: Volunteer. The page does not list pay for internships.
deadline_text: No deadline. Departments read forms when they need help. The city keeps your form for six months.
how_to_apply: Fill out the general youth form and name the department you want. The Animal Care Facility and library use their own forms. Send only one form in six months.
notes: Sending a form does not promise you a spot. If you get no spot in six months, you must apply again. Some park and recreation roles also need a background check and a short form about past crimes.
